facts.fact: TechCrunch reports that Guinea-based Cauridor operates remittance corridors to Ghana and Nigeria, with an agent network across Guinea, Senegal, Ivory Coast, Sierra Leone and Liberia.
Cauridor told TechCrunch its total payment volume across its payment rails was USD 300 million in 2023 and USD 500 million in 2024.

facts.fact: TechCrunch reports that Guinea-based fintech Cauridor recently raised USD 3.5 million in seed funding led by Oui Capital, with Rally Cap, BKR Capital and angel investors; the round has no date of its own.
